description: This file manages grouping functionalities within an Excalidraw-like drawing application, including selecting groups, handling group hierarchies, and retrieving group-related elements.

methods.name: selectGroup
methods.description: Selects or deselects a group based on its current state and the app state.

methods.name: selectGroupsForSelectedElements
methods.description: Determines and returns the group IDs for currently selected elements, with caching for optimization.

methods.name: isSelectedViaGroup
methods.description: Checks if an element is selected via its group.

methods.name: getSelectedGroupForElement
methods.description: Retrieves the group ID for an element if it is selected via a group.

methods.name: getSelectedGroupIds
methods.description: Returns an array of currently selected group IDs.

methods.name: selectGroupsFromGivenElements
methods.description: Determines group IDs from a list of elements based on the current app state.

methods.name: editGroupForSelectedElement
methods.description: Sets the app state to edit the group of a specific element.

methods.name: isElementInGroup
methods.description: Checks if an element belongs to a specific group.

methods.name: getElementsInGroup
methods.description: Retrieves all elements belonging to a specific group.

methods.name: getSelectedGroupIdForElement
methods.description: Finds the selected group ID for a given element.

methods.name: addToGroup
methods.description: Adds a new group ID to an element's group list at the appropriate position.

methods.name: removeFromSelectedGroups
methods.description: Removes specified group IDs from an element's group list.

methods.name: getMaximumGroups
methods.description: Returns arrays of elements grouped by their maximum group IDs, including bound text elements.

methods.name: getNonDeletedGroupIds
methods.description: Returns a set of group IDs associated with non-deleted elements.

methods.name: elementsAreInSameGroup
methods.description: Checks if all given elements are in the same group.

methods.name: isInGroup
methods.description: Checks if an element belongs to any group.

methods.name: getNewGroupIdsForDuplication
methods.description: Generates new group IDs for duplicated elements, applying a mapper function.

methods.name: getSelectedElementsByGroup
methods.description: Returns nested arrays of selected elements grouped by their immediate group, respecting hierarchy.
